observed.note: The cohort is close to balanced (56.1% curated silent), so the weighted score and the unweighted mean of the two arms differ by 0.013. The headline is therefore close to a balanced measure rather than an average dominated by the easier class, but it is not exactly one and both are reported.

never_fire.note: Calls every variant structurally silent. Scores every curated silent variant correct and misses every structural mechanism.

always_fold_and_ppi.note: Calls every variant destabilizing on both fold subtypes and binding.

always_monomer_fold.note: Calls every variant a monomer-fold destabilizer.

always_multimer_fold.note: Calls every variant a complex-context fold destabilizer.

always_ppi.note: Calls every variant an interface destabilizer.
